method: source RGB spatial features and temporal event heads v1

encoder.resize: RGB aspect-preserving OpenCV area/linear resize with ImageNet-mean letterbox padding
encoder.source_pixels: Complete oriented frame; no annotation-derived court, hitter or trajectory input
encoder.training_augmentation: True horizontal flip of normalized source-image tensor before encoder; family/side/hitter-end targets remain unchanged

context.camera_boundaries: Same AdaptiveDetector recipe as source perception; no cross-cut observations
context.missing: Zero features plus explicit availability mask; never invent a source frame

supervision.contact_interval: Published HitFrame maps to inclusive decoded ordinal bounds [max(0,H-1),min(N-1,H)] while zero/one convention is unresolved
supervision.zero_contact: Left-censored/unadjudicated contact0 retained in denominators; no exact timing or pre-video observation manufactured
supervision.rally_end: No terminal-time target; last stroke/winner/clip edge is not a landing label
supervision.status: Published weak supervision, not independent semantic or contact adjudication

training.class_weights: Inverse square root of supported training reference counts; training only
training.normalization: Training original and mirrored features only; std floor0.05, clipping[-10,10]
training.selection: Highest validation full spotted family/side/hitter-end tuple F1 over all references; ties contactF1 then earlier epoch
training.test_policy: No held-out head predictions before selected weights and validation threshold are frozen; no test selection or tuning

deployment.accuracy_claim: Research baseline only; weak-reference agreement does not establish full-match correctness
